overview_description.description: Matter Labs develops scaling solutions for Ethereum to make blockchain transactions faster, cheaper, and more efficient. Its main technology is zkSync, a Layer-2 protocol that uses zero-knowledge rollups to process many transactions off-chain while maintaining Ethereum-level security. The company was founded in 2018 with its head office in Berlin, Germany.
